notes.title: Last update for our 1st beta playtest
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, this is Kim from SYLOPON Games.

The final update for the first playtest of [i]The IRONY[/i] has just been released.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][list][*][p]When you parry an enemy with a shield, the protagonist will now be knocked back.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy physics have been improved to feel more natural. In particular, shotgun knockbacks now look much more impactful.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225764/d3adf83b962c7e35390e1d1df376ecfa3eec0a8e.png"][/img](this is my record)[/p][/*][*][p]At the end of the game, you’ll now see the agent’s codename, difficulty, and playtime displayed. Try challenging yourself with a speedrun or by clearing the hardest difficulty, Step-5!
[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]From here, we’re officially moving into the development of the demo version—that is, Chapter 1 of the full game. It’s a bit sad that we won’t be able to apply all of your thoughtful feedback immediately, but don’t worry! We’ll make sure it goes into the demo so we can deliver an even more exciting experience.[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing, and please don’t forget to add us to your Steam wishlist![/p][p]With gratitude,
[b]SYLOPON Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: small update with XBOX CONTROLLER SUPPORT!!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is KIM, the director of [b]The IRONY[/b].[/p][p]A new [b]playtest update[/b] has just been released.[/p][p][/p][p]This update includes [b]Xbox controller support[/b], one of the most requested features, along with multiple bug fixes, new cutscene elements, and significant visual improvements.


(before)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225764/5abde2c4c34c0a7e6be8dccbddac800a844fa3d3.png"][/img][/p][p](after)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225764/95f407dbfd96112898af2efbe770a6fcfe6d56ef.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve reworked the shader so the pixel look now [b]feels much sharper and more defined, rather than blurry.[/b][/p][p]The highlight of this update is, of course, [b]full Xbox controller support[/b]. We’ve implemented detailed vibration feedback for a complete experience, so if you previously played with keyboard and mouse, I highly recommend trying it again with an Xbox controller![/p][p][/p][p]We’re now shifting our focus to preparing the [b]demo build[/b]—Chapter 1 of [i]The IRONY[/i]. Our goal is to finish it by the end of the year, so this will likely be the last major playtest update. (Minor bug fixes will still be patched when necessary.)[/p][p][/p][p]Features like the [b]save system[/b] and [b]key rebinding[/b], which many of you requested, will be implemented in the demo version.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all once again for your support! From now on, we’ll be sharing more updates in the form of demo development logs.[/p][p](The playtest will wrap up in [b]September[/b].)[/p]

notes.title: The IRONY playtest is now finally released
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, this is KIM, the director of the game.
We’ve now passed the Steam build test, which means the playtest is officially underway! Most of you who signed up should already have access.[/p][p]Many more people are still applying for the playtest, but in order to ensure the best possible experience, we’ll be pausing new playtest approvals until the next update. (Existing users will still be able to play.)[/p][p]We’ve had far more players join than expected, and since this is still a beta build, there are many issues regarding bugs, stability, and overall convenience. Our plan is to fix as many of these as possible before the next release.[/p][p]Here are the main features and fixes planned for the upcoming update:[/p][list][*][p]Xbox controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Improved key mapping for DualSense controllers (we know R1 for attack was uncomfortable)[/p][/*][*][p]Controller sprint toggle option[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to overly loud sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Several bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Chinese and Japanese text rendering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for certain crash issues[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any bugs or inconveniences, please send us your feedback via email or Discord—we’re doing our best to incorporate as much as possible.[/p][p][b]Email[/b]
[/p][p][url="https://simsim179300@naver.com"]simsim179300@naver.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Discord[/b]
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/6YMQNppYfk"]https://discord.gg/6YMQNppYfk[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This version is an early build focused on showcasing the game’s core fun, a vertical slice, and some quality-of-life improvements. That means it may feel a bit rough or incomplete in places.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your patience! In the upcoming demo release, we’ll be making many improvements and presenting a much more polished experience. And for that, your feedback is truly invaluable.[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing our game—we’ll be back with the next update![/p]
